Planner usage

Simulations started—Run simulation and explicit Plan Lab runs; excludes automatic live estimates and target searches.

Referral sources

SourcePlanner arrivals

Counts start with this release. Each planner page load from an external source or without a referrer is an arrival, not a unique visitor. Internal navigation is excluded. Missing referrers appear as Direct / unknown. Browser blocking and offline use can reduce counts. ChatGPT-signed-in owner activity is excluded; other owner use and automated events may be counted. Only referral hostnames and event counts are stored; no plan inputs or results are uploaded.

Assistant forecast tools

Calculation calls—
Completed—
ToolOutcomeDurationCalls

Hosted calculation attempts that reach execution, including owner tests. A comparison counts as one call. Discovery, methodology, authentication rejection and schema rejection are excluded. Aggregate counts contain no forecast inputs, results or account identifiers. Browser simulations are counted separately.

Pro subscriptions & revenue

Loading Stripe figures…

Active paid Pro subscriptions—Current snapshot; excludes trials, zero-price plans and complimentary access.
Monthly recurring value—Current recurring list prices before discounts or tax; yearly plans divided by 12.
Gross collected in range—Pro invoice payments by payment date, including tax; before refunds and fees. USD.

Subscriptions are counted, not distinct people. Scheduled cancellations remain active until their paid access ends. Gross collected includes payments for subscriptions that have since ended. Test-mode figures are labeled and do not represent real revenue.

Cloudflare counts page views when it serves an HTML page through the custom domain. The planner's internal tabs do not each count as a new page view. Unique visitor IPs are an estimate of people, not a person-level count; bots, shared networks, and changing IP addresses can affect it. Visits to the separate chatgpt.site address are outside these figures. Today is partial, and Cloudflare may report data with a delay.
